packages.name: Backwaters and Ayurveda
packages.summary: Houseboat night, Munnar tea hills and an Ayurvedic massage.
highlights: Tea estates and spice walks in Munnar

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi
itinerary.text: Airport pickup, hotel check-in and an evening walk by the Chinese fishing nets.

itinerary.title: Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.text: Drive through the hills with a waterfall stop, then settle into your resort.

itinerary.title: Munnar tea country
itinerary.text: Visit a tea estate, Mattupetty Dam and a sunset viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey
itinerary.text: Scenic drive and boarding your houseboat in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Backwater day
itinerary.text: Cruise the canals, have a home-style Kerala lunch and an Ayurvedic massage.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Breakfast and transfer to Kochi airport.

packages.name: Leh, Nubra and Pangong
packages.summary: High passes, Hunder dunes and a night by Pangong lake.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Leh
itinerary.text: Rest day to adjust to the altitude. Short walk to Leh market.

itinerary.title: Leh sightseeing
itinerary.text: Shey Palace, Thiksey Monastery and Hemis in the afternoon.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra
itinerary.text: Cross Khardung La and reach Hunder by evening.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley
itinerary.text: Camel ride in the dunes and a visit to Diskit Monastery.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong
itinerary.text: Drive via Shyok to the lake and stay in camps.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh
itinerary.text: Sunrise at the lake, then a long drive back to Leh.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Transfer to Leh airport.

packages.name: Golden Triangle
packages.summary: Delhi, Agra and Jaipur with private guides.
highlights: Amber Fort with a local guide

itinerary.title: Arrive in Delhi
itinerary.text: Pickup, hotel check-in and an evening at India Gate.

itinerary.title: Delhi sightseeing
itinerary.text: Red Fort, Jama Masjid and a food walk in Old Delhi.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Agra
itinerary.text: Drive to Agra, visit Agra Fort and see the sunset at Mehtab Bagh.

itinerary.title: Agra to Jaipur
itinerary.text: Taj Mahal at sunrise, then drive to Jaipur via Fatehpur Sikri.

itinerary.title: Jaipur
itinerary.text: Amber Fort, City Palace, Hawa Mahal and the bazaars.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Transfer to Jaipur airport or station.

packages.name: Goa Beach Break
packages.summary: Beaches, old Goa churches and sunset cafes.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Goa
itinerary.text: Pickup and hotel check-in. Evening at Calangute beach.

itinerary.title: North Goa
itinerary.text: Baga, Anjuna and Vagator beaches, Chapora Fort at sunset.

itinerary.title: Old Goa and Panjim
itinerary.text: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Fontainhas walk and a river dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Breakfast and airport drop.

packages.name: Kashmir Valley
packages.summary: Shikara ride on Dal Lake and the meadows of Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar
itinerary.text: Pickup, houseboat check-in and an evening Shikara ride.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.text: Mughal gardens, Shankaracharya Temple and old city market.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg
itinerary.text: Day trip with the gondola ride and snow or meadow walks.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam
itinerary.text: Betaab Valley and Aru Valley with a riverside lunch.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Transfer to Srinagar airport.

packages.name: Rishikesh and Haridwar
packages.summary: Ganga aarti, a yoga session and optional river rafting.
highlights: Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri

itinerary.title: Arrive in Haridwar
itinerary.text: Check-in and Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri.

itinerary.title: Haridwar to Rishikesh
itinerary.text: Mansa Devi temple, then Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh
itinerary.text: Morning yoga, optional rafting and the evening aarti at Triveni Ghat.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Breakfast and drop to Haridwar station or Dehradun airport.

packages.name: Ayodhya Darshan
packages.summary: Temple darshan and the evening aarti on the Sarayu.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Ayodhya
itinerary.text: Check-in, Hanuman Garhi and Kanak Bhawan. Evening Sarayu aarti.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya darshan
itinerary.text: Ram temple darshan in the morning, then drop to the station.

packages.name: Darjeeling and Gangtok
packages.summary: Toy train, tea gardens and Kanchenjunga views.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Bagdogra
itinerary.text: Drive to Darjeeling and check in.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling
itinerary.text: Tiger Hill sunrise, tea garden visit and a toy train ride.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Gangtok
itinerary.text: Scenic drive and an evening at MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Gangtok
itinerary.text: Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir day trip.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Drive to Bagdogra airport or NJP station.
